scope: Pre-dispatch implementation and artifact review only; not a judge result, semantic regrading, user authorization or training readiness attestation.

payload_checks.candidate_text_execution: none; strings are serialized as JSON data

cost_eligibility.basis: Reserve the entire advertised/enforced provider context as input plus a separate full completion allowance, conservatively double-counting output if the context is combined. No tokenizer or server framing count is needed.
required_dispatch_conditions: Fresh provider catalog confirms exact active model, 262144 context, and unchanged uncached input/output rates before the only POST
Provider honors its published context, billing and total-completion contract including reasoning
One experiment-wide exclusive allowance is consumed before directory dispatch and retained across failures and alternate output directories
No inference retry, continuation or alternate model
cost_eligibility.rejected_ultra_option: No eligibility attestation: unexposed hosted tokenizer/framing could not establish its proposed sub-$0.50 bound. The amended full-context Super bound removes that assumption.

identity_scope.even_perfect_score_agreement: Alias-scoped diagnostic agreement only; cannot pass immutable-judge readiness, validate a production reward or authorize training.
identity_scope.original_contract: Preserved unchanged; immutable revision condition remains unmet.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Directory-local consumption allowed another output directory to refresh the paid attempt.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Fixed experiment-wide exclusive allowance is consumed before POST; alternate-directory regression retains exactly one dispatch.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Named judge scoring lacked response identity and manifest/request/fixture/response bindings.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Saved scoring verifies canonical hashes, exact served model and raw usage. Missing/mismatched bindings yield an inconclusive result; default pure comparison cannot attest a named run.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Per-I/O timeout plus post-chunk elapsed checks did not enforce a hard absolute wall deadline.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Limits and amendment explicitly describe a 240-second per-I/O timeout plus soft elapsed guard; they do not claim a hard absolute deadline.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Scorer rejected valid facts solely because they arrived out of reference order, which the prompt did not require.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Exact unique fact-ID membership is checked and canonicalized after validation; reversed-order and duplicate-fact regressions reviewed.

findings_and_resolutions.finding: Non-object response or null/list usage could crash saved scoring before an inconclusive record.
findings_and_resolutions.resolution: Raw bodies are retained, usage is safely typed, and malformed/unverifiable bodies yield inconclusive/missing-case diagnostics.

failure_and_gate_review: HTTP destination allowlist, no redirect following, proxy environment disabled and transport retries=0
Paid uncertainty consumes the only attempt; missing usage is unknown, never zero cost
Raw response is retained before analysis; unknown/missing/duplicate/schema-invalid judgments prevent passing and do not silently discard other valid case results
All seven predeclared score-error maxima remain zero; authored labels and future judge judgments remain distinct
Reserved reader evaluation questions, references and paper contents are not used
Batched diagnostic does not validate independent one-case production judging or population reliability

local_functions_run: request_payload on the frozen development fixtures

test_execution_attribution: Tests were inspected; implementing agent executes focused/full tests separately. No test pass count is independently asserted by this reviewer.
review_renewal: Any later change to these exact code/test/data/amendment bytes requires renewal before relying on this attestation.
